sections.markdown:
## C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Basic driving

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A30
Inspect behind the vehicle before entering because children and small objects may be invisible from the driver’s seat. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A30
For the handbook’s backing procedure, keep a foot on the brake while selecting Reverse. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A30
When backing as described, hold the wheel with the left hand at 12 o’clock, put the right arm behind the passenger seat and look through the rear window. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A30
Use mirrors while reversing but remember they cannot show the area directly behind the vehicle. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A30
Back slowly with gentle acceleration because the vehicle is harder to steer in reverse. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A30
While backing, make small steering movements toward the direction the vehicle’s rear should go. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A30
If reversing through a turn, briefly check the front and sides and continue watching behind until fully stopped. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0030]

ranked.label: Pedagogic emphasis: Prepare, observe and move smoothly; preserve safe steering and backing posture.
